name: CropWheat
description: One 1 m tilled-bed plot of drilled wheat, 27 tillered plants on three ridges, from a green braird to a straw-gold stand; the ears are separate instanced produce.
provenance: Original project-authored procedural geometry and numpy-painted textures; no third-party asset.

wind.B: leaf flutter 0.1 at the sheath -> 1 at the tip

crop_layout: 27 plants (4 tillers each) along the ridges y=-0.3,0,+0.3; base z=0.045 m.
material_notes: One M_CropWheat atlas: alpha in basecolor; roughness R, translucency G, AO B. Ears use M_CropWheatProduce (re-parented to M_CropProduce in Unreal).
harvest_mesh: SM_CropWheat_Harvest: tied sheaf, grip at the band (origin), ears hang down -Z.
